headline: Engineering AI-enabled software solutions, high-performance backends, and seamless digital experiences.
paragraphs: Hello! I am Hema Varshini Kommoju, a Software Developer specializing in AI-integrated Full-Stack and Backend Development. I have hands-on experience designing and delivering scalable web and mobile applications from concept to deployment.

My technical expertise centers on architecting high-performance backend APIs using FastAPI and Node.js, alongside integrating AI capabilities including LLM-driven chatbots, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server architecture, speech-to-text (STT) processing, and conversational workflows. On the frontend, I engineer responsive, accessible applications using ReactJS and Flutter.

With a solid foundation in Python, Java, database management (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), and RESTful microservices, I am passionate about end-to-end AI-enabled software solutions, prompt engineering, and agile product development.
